what: The progress bar fills from the left over four beats (1.7s) while the number beside it counts from 0% to 100%. When full, the result line floats up 8px in one beat, and two beats later the link slides in from −8px at the side

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.loop: If present, rest five beats and repeat (demo version)
